data.name: Description
data.value: A server or storage that only offers SFTP. BorgStudio mounts the folder with sshfs and borg writes to it like to a local folder – slower than borg on the server. Needs sshfs where borg runs (WSL, Linux, macOS).

data.name: HostInvalid
data.value: The server name is not valid.

data.name: PortInvalid
data.value: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.

data.name: UserInvalid
data.value: The login name may only contain letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.

data.name: PathHint
data.value: Relative to the login's home folder (e.g. backups/laptop) or absolute. Its parent folder must exist; a new repository's folder is created.

data.name: PathInvalid
data.value: The folder may not contain “..” and must name a folder below the home or root folder.
